sentences.text: The genus is defined by a holotype — the specimen the species is based on — which includes a well-preserved left maxilla measuring 230 millimeters in length and 100 millimeters in height. This bone is shaped like an isosceles triangle with a strong longitudinal bulge on its medial surface and bears at least 25 teeth featuring a prominent median primary ridge and mamillated denticles on the crown margins.
Referred materials include an isolated maxillary tooth that stands about 25 to 28 millimeters tall and is roughly 14 to 17 millimeters wide.
Éric Buffetaut and Varavudh Suteethorn first named the genus in 2011, giving it the specific name nimngami to honor Witaya Nimngam, who donated the specimens to the researchers.
Siamodon belongs to the class Ornithischia and is classified within the parent group Hadrosauriformes.

Fossils were collected from the Khok Kruat Formation in Nakhon Ratchasima Province, dating to the Aptian stage of the late Early Cretaceous, approximately 125 to 113 million years ago. The specific time range for Siamodon is the Aptian stage, from 121.4 to 113.2 million years ago.
